newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Twelve killed in Seoul restaurant fire.
newsitem.headline: Twelve killed in Seoul restaurant fire.

text.p: Twelve people were killed and three seriously injured when a fire sparked by a gas explosion ripped through a cafe packed with young holiday revellers in Seoul on Sunday, fire officials said.
The victims were trapped by flames that spread quickly through the cramped basement Rolling Stones cafe in a fashionable bar district of the South Korean capital.
Television pictures showed the blackened interior of the cafe with a handful of charred tables and chairs. A stove using bottled gas stood next to the bar.
The fire broke out late on the last day of the four-day Korean Thanksgiving holiday.
